title: ArcBio Continuous RNA Workflow - Post-PCR Pooling
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Transfer libraries to pool tubes
steps.instruction: Use the p20 single‑channel pipette to transfer the volume specified in the uploaded CSV file for each library into the appropriate pool tube; each pool uses three source columns (24 libraries) and there are four pool tubes total.

substeps.instruction: Load the CSV file that lists the transfer volume for each library.
For each library, aspirate the listed volume with the p20 single‑channel pipette.
Dispense the aspirated volume into the designated pool tube (four tubes total, each receiving libraries from three source columns, i.e., 24 libraries per pool).
